cohort: 952 children aged 3-12 years in Basrah, Iraq, including 407 children with asthma and 545 age-matched controls without asthma
finding: Caesarean section delivery was independently associated with a 3.37-fold increased risk of childhood asthma.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was found to be an independent significant risk factor for asthma, increasing the risk by more than three times.
